confucius-analects-compiled.description: Several seated men in dark, loose robes bend over bundles of bamboo slips on a woven mat floor, writing with brushes in a dim wooden hall lit warmly from one side. A low wooden table sits in the back, and a bronze or stone stand holds an ink dish in the foreground. The slips show faint marks but no legible text. Dark oil-painting style, filling the whole frame.

epicurus-founds-garden-school.description: An older bearded man with grey hair, in a dark cloak, sits on a stone bench under a fig tree, gesturing with one hand and holding a flatbread. Four people listen nearby: a woman seated on the ground, a woman standing behind, and two men, one holding bread. Bowls of figs, olives and bread sit on the ground, with clay amphorae at the edges. Behind them is a ruined stone wall covered in ivy, with a low sun in the background. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no text or border.

laozi-tao-te-ching.description: A bald, bearded old man in a grey robe rides a black water buffalo through misty mountains. Behind him is a tiled-roof gate tower on a stone wall, with pines on the cliffs. A younger man in dark armour with a topknot and a sword on his back reaches up to take a bundle of bamboo slips from the old man's hand. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no text.

nagarjuna-middle-way-verses.description: A seated shaven-headed monk in orange robes meditates on a stone plinth beneath a large gnarled tree, with a seven-hooded cobra rising behind him like a canopy. A stupa with carved relief panels stands to the right, and dim silhouetted figures sit in the lower corners. Dark, warm oil-painting style, no visible text, and the painting runs edge to edge.

avicenna-book-of-healing.description: An older bearded man in a white turban and dark hooded robe sits cross-legged in a vaulted brick cellar lined with stacked books and chests. He writes with a reed pen on an open book on a carved wooden lectern. A brass astrolabe lies on the floor beside a sprig of dried herbs, and an oil lamp burns on a small wooden crate. No text or frame is visible; the image fills the square edge to edge.

wang-yangming-great-awakening.description: A painted portrait of an older East Asian man with short dark hair and a thin goatee, in a loose brown-grey robe with a crossed collar, seated inside a rocky cave opening. Behind him is a dark blue-grey night sky with misty mountain silhouettes. Oil-painting style, dim lighting, one hand resting on his knee. No visible text apart from a tiny mark in the bottom-right corner. The painting runs edge to edge with no frame.
